top_signals.title: Odd Lots: What Does It Take to Make Bonds Less Risky Again?
top_signals.summary: On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, Carolin Pflueger, associate professor at the University of Chicago, joins Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal to discuss why Treasury and global bond yields have been surging and what central banks have to do to make bonds more “bond-like” again. (Source: Bloomberg)
